genesis.eligibility: The first 1,000 verified nodes: one immutable X user ID with an observed Premium or PremiumPlus tier linked to one public Solana wallet through OAuth plus a wallet-signature challenge.
genesis.claimModel: First-come claimable after the verified Genesis record is public. A slot is reserved only after the X link and wallet-signature challenge both complete; never sent to an unlinked or unverified wallet.

daily.epoch: Previous closed UTC day. No retroactive edits after the manifest is published.
daily.qualifyingAction: One original X post or reply that matches the public daily prompt, includes the canonical campaign tag, and is returned by the official X API collection job.
excludedActions: activity outside the closed UTC window

budget.consumptionRule: Every amount placed in a published epoch permanently consumes lifetime budget, whether later claimed or expired.
oversubscriptionInputs: predeclared finalized Solana slot hash after snapshot
budget.exhaustionRule: Stop creating claims when 365 epochs are published, fewer than 12 IAT remain, or the next epoch would exceed either cap. Never create debt, prorate, refill, or silently reassign an expired claim.

fairness.walletBinding: A wallet may bind to only one X account; an X account may bind to only one wallet until a documented cooldown and re-verification complete.
fairness.auditability: Each epoch publishes its UTC window, policy hash, eligible-wallet count, total claimable amount, manifest digest, and Merkle root before claims open.
fairness.manualHold: Suspicious or duplicate activity is held from that epoch and documented; it is never silently reassigned.

distribution.model: Merkle-proof manifests and unsigned distribution batches are prepared offline. The web application has no signing key and cannot submit a transfer.
distribution.payer: The owner-controlled Trezor Model T is the only signing device. Every bounded batch requires physical review and confirmation; no hot distributor key or separate authority is authorized.

disclosure: Participation rewards are campaign rewards, not yield, not interest, not APY, and not a promise of value. Eligibility and claims remain subject to the published epoch evidence.
